title: Beit Baitos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 57a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.57a.8), Abba Shaul ben Batnit said in the name of Abba Yosef ben Chanin: “Woe to me because of the house of Baitos; woe to me because of their clubs.” They were among the high priests of the Second Temple period.[^1]

notes.text: Abba Shaul ben Batnit transmits the lament in the name of Abba Yosef ben Chanin. The linked passage goes on to describe the high-priestly households and the offices held by their families.
